main_topics.reason: The user asked whether the reduction in migraine days on Emgality means it is working and returned to this question throughout the conversation.
The user worried their neurologist might stop the medication for not reaching a 50% reduction and asked what to raise at reassessment.
The user noticed their remaining migraines had become less severe and recognized this as possible improvement.
The user described logging migraine days in an app and discussed what to keep recording before reassessment.

output.summary: The user asked whether a reduction from about 20 to 15 migraine days per month after three months on Emgality counts as a response, and later noted their attacks were less severe. The assistant framed this as partial improvement, suggested continuing to track symptoms and discussing reassessment and options with their neurologist; the user said they felt much better and saw the treatment as working, though not finished.
